Timed Research

Pokémon GO and Duolingo Timed Research

Tue, Nov 17, 2026, 10:00 AM → Thu, Dec 31, 2026, 11:59 PM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

A Pokémon GO × Duolingo team-up: practise a language in Duolingo for a week to earn a code for free Timed Research in Pokémon GO, with Pokémon wearing a special background.

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

How to get it

  • In Duolingo, join the Pokémon event quest (it started Nov 17).
  • Complete a lesson on seven different days to earn a code.
  • Redeem the code in the Pokémon GO Web Store to unlock the Timed Research.

Rewards

  • Encounters with Pikachu, Meowth, Chatot and Lucario with a special background.
  • Some Pokémon from the research show a language tag on their summary page, a new feature.

Deadline

  • Finish the research by Thursday, Dec 31, 11:59 p.m. local time.

Tip

Start your Duolingo days early: the code needs seven separate days of lessons, and the research itself also has to be done before the year ends.
